title: MACAW: Reliable And Efficient Surgical Debridement Using Monocular Adaptive Compact Attention Windows
snippet: We develop an augmented dexterity system for surgical debridement that uses visual servoing to align the cable-driven gripper with the target position in the image plane, and then introduces a novel approach to depth control, MACAW: Monocular Adaptive Compact Attention Windows.
